label: income statement
description: This page is Apple Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Operations, taken from its 2024 Form 10-K (page 29). Figures are in millions of dollars except share counts (in thousands) and per-share amounts. It reports results for the fiscal years ended September 28, 2024, September 30, 2023, and September 24, 2022. Line items include Net sales (Products, Services, Total net sales), Cost of sales (Products, Services, Total cost of sales, Gross margin), Operating expenses (Research and development, Selling general and administrative, Total operating expenses), Operating income, Other income/(expense) net, Income before provision for income taxes, Provision for income taxes, Net income, Earnings per share (Basic, Diluted), and Shares used in computing earnings per share (Basic, Diluted). Key printed figures: Total net sales 391,035 / 383,285 / 394,328; Gross margin 180,683 / 169,148 / 170,782; Operating income 123,216 / 114,301 / 119,437; Net income 93,736 / 96,995 / 99,803; Diluted EPS 6.08 / 6.13 / 6.11. A note directs readers to the accompanying Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements.

label: comprehensive income
description: This page is Apple Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income, presented in millions of U.S. dollars for the fiscal years ended September 28, 2024, September 30, 2023, and September 24, 2022. It begins with Net income of $93,736, $96,995, and $99,803 respectively. Under Other comprehensive income/(loss), the Change in foreign currency translation, net of tax, is 395, (765), and (1,511). The Change in fair value of derivative instruments is (832), 323, and 3,212, with an adjustment for realized gains/losses of (1,337), (1,717), and (1,074), giving a total change on derivative instruments of (2,169), (1,394), and 2,138. For marketable debt securities, the fair value change is 5,850, 1,563, and (12,104), with a realized adjustment of 204, 253, and 205, totaling 6,054, 1,816, and (11,899). Total other comprehensive income/(loss) is 4,280, (343), and (11,272). Total comprehensive income is $98,016, $96,652, and $88,531. The footer reads "Apple Inc. 2024 Form 10-K | 30."

label: balance sheet
description: This page is Apple Inc.'s Consolidated Balance Sheets, presented in millions of dollars except for share counts (shares in thousands, par value $0.00001), comparing fiscal year-end September 28, 2024 with September 30, 2023. Current assets include Cash and cash equivalents ($29,943 / $29,965), Marketable securities ($35,228 / $31,590), Accounts receivable, net ($33,410 / $29,508), Vendor non-trade receivables ($32,833 / $31,477), Inventories ($7,286 / $6,331), Other current assets ($14,287 / $14,695), and Total current assets ($152,987 / $143,566). Non-current assets total $211,993 / $209,017, giving Total assets of $364,980 / $352,583. Current liabilities include Accounts payable ($68,960 / $62,611), Other current liabilities ($78,304 / $58,829), Deferred revenue ($8,249 / $8,061), Commercial paper ($9,967 / $5,985), Term debt ($10,912 / $9,822), totaling $176,392 / $145,308. Non-current liabilities total $131,638 / $145,129; Total liabilities $308,030 / $290,437. Shareholders' equity shows Common stock and additional paid-in capital ($83,276 / $73,812), Accumulated deficit ($19,154 / $214), Accumulated other comprehensive loss ($7,172 / $11,452), Total shareholders' equity $56,950 / $62,146. Footer cites Form 10-K, page 31.

label: cash flows
description: This page is Apple Inc.'s Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, presented in millions of U.S. dollars for the fiscal years ended September 28, 2024, September 30, 2023, and September 24, 2022. It reports cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash and cash equivalents, beginning balances of $30,737, $24,977, and $35,929 respectively. Operating activities begin with net income of 93,736, 96,995, and 99,803, plus adjustments such as depreciation and amortization (11,445; 11,519; 11,104) and share-based compensation expense (11,688; 10,833; 9,038), yielding cash generated by operating activities of 118,254, 110,543, and 122,151. Investing activities total 2,935, 3,705, and (22,354). Financing activities total (121,983), (108,488), and (110,749). Ending balances are $29,943, $30,737, and $24,977. A supplemental disclosure shows cash paid for income taxes, net of 26,102, 18,679, and 19,573. The page is from Apple Inc.'s 2024 Form 10-K.

label: stock performance chart
description: This page is from Apple Inc.'s 2024 Form 10-K, under the heading "Company Stock Performance." It presents a line graph titled "COMPARISON OF 5-YEAR CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN Among Apple Inc., the S&P 500 Index and the Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index," showing five-year cumulative total shareholder return on a dividend-reinvested basis, assuming $100 invested at the market close on September 27, 2019. The graph's vertical axis runs from $0 to $500, with x-axis dates from 9/27/19 to 9/28/24. A data table below lists values in dollars for September 2019 through September 2024. Apple Inc. figures are $100, $207, $273, $281, $322, and $430. The S&P 500 Index figures are $100, $113, $156, $131, $155, and $210. The Dow Jones U.S. Technology Supersector Index figures are $100, $146, $216, $156, $215, and $322. The page concludes with "Item 6. [Reserved]." A footer reads "Apple Inc. | 2024 Form 10-K | 20."
